tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// bshes gnyen rnam rgyal grags pa'i dris lan bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnam rgyal grags pa'i mtshan 'dzin pa gang gi phyag tu phul ba/ ri mo bkra shis kha rtags gser/ rten khebs dang bcas pa/ nye gnas pas gtsang chu'i 'jigs pa khyad du gsad der ma stod du yod thog 'byor pas yid tshim/ nyid paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs la legs par sbyangs pa/ karma kam tshang gi tshogs kyi dbus su legs par 'doms pa'i 'chad nyan thugs ka rdzogs par bgyis te/ chos grwa de nyid du lhun chags par bzhugs mchis pa spro/ da lam kho bo'i spyod tshul la brten pa'i dri ba mdzad 'dug pa bdag la bstod// gzhan la smod pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod tshul ma yin/ nga che'o snyam rlom sems dang de sgrub pa'ang snga ma dang mtshungs par mthong kyang*/ da lam nyid rgyal ba'i chos la sbyangs// rnam spyod kyi spyan yangs pas gleng bslang ba 'di lta bu la/ lkugs pa'i tshul gzung na 'os min par bsams nas// gzhan gleng ba po dang*// bdag gi tshul/ shākya thub pa'i lugs su mthun/ nyid kyi dpyad gzhir mdzod cig ces drang por smras so// de la nyid kyi tshig 'dir ma bkod na bdag gis ci smras sam/ dgongs srid pas/ de yang bkod de lan du bgyis pa/ mkhyen pa'i snang bas shes bya'i gnas kun khyab// brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba dbang du sdud// nus pas rgol ngan spobs pa mtha' dag 'joms// rgyal ba'i sras po rgyal ba'i myu gu la// bdag g.yo rgyu dang zol zog min par rang gi the tshom dang yid gnyis kyi dra ba gcod pa'i phyir/ tshig 'ga' zhig zhu na/ nyid kyi snyan pa dang grags pa yang thos/ skabs de dang de'i mi mthun phyogs kyang thos shing*// nyid paṇa chen nā ro'i skye ba'o zhes rlung ltar grags shing*/ zhal gyis yang bzhes 'dug zer ba la dpag gsan/ rgyu mtshan gzhan yod (2na3)pa yang srid/ lo ras kyi rnam thar bka' rgya ma na/ slob dpon padma'i zhal nas/

mkhan po bo dhi sa twa khyo da ma 'ongs pa na nā ro par 'gyur zhing*/ de nas gtsang pa rgya ras/ de nas rgyal po'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad gsung ba cig 'dug pa la dgongs/ rgyal po bya ba chos rgyal du byas/ de'i sku'i skye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin na/ zhes gsung ba 'di'i thad du/ 'di na gter nas chos tshad ldan ma 'thon de thams cad brdzus ma'o zhes smras pa dang*/ bdag nyid chen por bsgrub pa dang gzhan smod pa la gter yig gi lung bstan 'di rnams 'di yod ces smra ba'ang mthong*/ de lta bu min par bdag ni rnying ma bka' gter tshad ldan la gus// gter rdzus la dpyad de btang snyoms su 'jog pas/ lung drangs kyang 'os pa nyid yin pas// chos rje rgya ras la// sa ral zhes bya'i lung gsum mdor// nor bu 'dzin pa'i sprul pa byung*// pha bong sho 'dra'i kha nas chos 'chad rtsom// zhes spyan ras gzigs mu lung bstan pa/ chos dbang gi gter yig /gzhan yang kong gter lho gter mang por nā ro par lung bstan 'dug /dkar brgyud rang gi zhang g.yu brag pas// nā ro pa'i dbu skra gcod mkhan nga min pa su yod ces/ rgod ma dkar mo la zhon nas brgyug pa kun mthun grub tu gleng*/ de bzhin gling ras kyi gdan sa thel gyi gnas bstod du/ dpral ba'i dkyil nas mdongs cig byung*/ mdongs de gling chen ras pa yin// mdongs kyi dkyil nas 'od cig byung*/ 'od de nā ro paṇa chen yin// zer ba 'dug /thams cad bkod kyang mang snang*// gtsang pa rgya ras nyid kyis// skye bzhi'i gong rol kha che'i yul gyi lho// ko sa la zhes grags pa'i grong khyer der// mu stegs ma yin bram ze'i rigs su skyes// de tshang ming ye shes dngos grub 'bod// ces nā ro par zhal gyis bzhes// 'dir yang gdung gso ba brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i dgus// ces gdung rabs de nyid du sprul pa'i sku dgu (2ba4)'byung bar lung bstan pa'i thog mar rgyal dbang rje yin pa gtan tshigs mang du snang*// de'i sprul pa bya rigs su byon pa som nyi ma mchis// kho bo de'i sprul par bya paṇḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal la sogs pas brtags dpyad byas pas mgu// khyad par rdo rje chos kyi spyan ldan 'brug pa rin po ches dkon mchog la zla ba gcig tu ched du bya ba 'di kho nas gsol ba btab pas slu ba med par lung bstan no gsung ba'i bka' tham 'byor pa dang*/

chung ngu'i dus khas 'che ba yang byas 'dug /da lta yin par 'dod pa la yin/ man par 'dod pa la man byas pas chog par mchis/ sgrub byed dgos pa'i dal ba med do// yang nyid kyis/ de'i sku'i skye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin na// gzhan phyogs pa'i skye bo 'ga' dang 'ga'i bsam pa la// skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyi skye ba dang sprul pa gang yin rung*/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi bsrung skyobs mdzad pa ma gtogs bag med kyi spyod pa 'di lta bu ci la mdzad// 'di ni 'tshe ba chos su smra ba sems can bslu bar byed pa zhig go// snyam du byed pa yod srid pas// skyes bu dam pa rnams la log lta skyes na// med par lta bas rtsa ba gcod// dge dang mi dge med lta ba// log par lta ba yin zhes gsungs// rang rgyud la yod pa'i 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi dge ba chad na ngan song du lhung bar 'gyur la/ bdag la brten nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang gnod par ma gyur cig /skyes bu dam pa la brten nas sems can rnams g.yang sar lhung na mi rung bas// thabs sna tshogs kyi sgro nas skye bo ngan pa'i log lta srol dgos cing*/ de yang so so skye bo rnams rdzu 'phrul la yid gtod par byed pa yin la/ rdzu 'phrul sngags dang sman dang las las skyes pa dang*/ bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skyes pa la sogs pa las/ mi la skyes stobs kyi rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes mod/ 'byung pos brlams pa ni ma ni la che// rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes (3na5)sam/ pha rol gyi sems dri bcas dri med gang rung la brten nas// skye bo ngan pa rnams kyi the tshom log lta bsal te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la 'jug pa cig cis kyang gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen/ de ltar ma gnang bar sems can blo rigs sna tshogs pa de dag dge yang rung*// sdig kyang rung*// ci dga' gyis snyam du bor nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la sems can blos btang ba dang*/

rdzu 'phrul sdig la sogs ma byed ces nyes par 'gyur ba ma lags sam// zhes gsung ba la/ bdag lo dgu nas dkar brgyud rin po che'i bstan 'dzin la gtugs gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs/ lo bcu bzhi nas dkar brgyud kyi gdams ngag tshig shes tsam byung nas don gnyer la bshad/ lo bcu bdun nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ dge slong gi bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa shes pa'i phyir 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i pusta ka mig gis ltas/ don la dpyad/ zhar la phar tshad dbu mngon gyi gzhung thos pa bgyid bsam/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan gyi gsung ngag rnams thog mar lta ba'i mig tu byas// rgya bod tshad thub kyi gzhung glegs bam du ma la sbyangs pas lung dang rigs pa smra ba la 'gran zla med par grags/ de gzhan ma'i thugs su ma shong bas phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis bdud du gleng bas// smra ba'i seng ge rtsod khab la 'drer skyes zer smad pa dang 'dra/ nged kyis bdud byas de 'dul bar rloms na/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas nas phebs dgos pa 'dra lags/ gzhan gyi dad pas phul ba'i nor chud zos na mi rung snyam/ dpal bkra shis mthong smon gyi gtsug lag khang*/ rgyal byed tshal/ yang rtse/ dpal ri/ byams pa chos gling*/ tsa ri/ gsang sngags chos gling sogs nang bzhugs rten chen dge 'dun gyi sde/ log 'tsho med pa'i 'tshog chas/ dbus gtsang na'ang 'gran zla med pa 'ga' zhig bsgrubs/ gos sku gsum dang*/ (3ba6)rgyal ba'i gsung rab bzhengs/ dbus gtsang du sdod dus/ sa dge kar rnying kun la srid zhur byas pas/ ding sang ngam ring*/ dpal 'khor bde chen/ rta se skyed tshal/ bya gshongs/ bsang phu ser 'bras dge gsum kun tu/ kho bo dang chos kyi 'brel ba can mang*/ blo gsal de dag bdag la bstod pa'i gnas su byed pa 'di kho bos byas pa'i bag med/ gzhan gyi bag yod cir 'dug ltas na/ skye bo mgo bskor/ brgya shig nas stong 'gugs thabs sogs rgyu nor rang shed 'thon par gzhan phyogs kyi dgon pa bsgyur// rang 'og tu 'dzud thabs kyi g.yo sgyu khram gsum ma lags sam gzigs/

sangs rgyas su khas len pa dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yod rgyud byed pa ni/ mi tshes bla ma'i rdzun du snang bas/ blun po'i ngo na mdzes kyang ston pas sdom pa 'jig pa'i rkyen du gsungs 'dug pas ma nus so// nor longs spyod sprin bzhin 'dus tsa na/ khong chen po phal gyi gnyid thabs bcag /gsung ba ltar lags/ don la ston pa sangs rgyas la lhas byin gyis rgyogs rgyab/ dkrod rtses byas/ ma skyes dgras glang po che 'bras chang gi myos pa rbad/ bram ze'i grong du dge sbyong go'u ta ma 'ong ba'i shul lam du spu gri'i char 'bab pa la sogs pa khram byas pa bden snyam/ rgyal pos mtshams bcad pas ston pa 'khor bcas zla ba gsum du rta chag rul ba gsol dgos pa byung 'dug /ma skyes dgras 'gyod tshang byas/ lhas byin lus de nyid kyi dmyal bar song ba ma gzigs sam/ bdag mthong ngam tshul thos na de dag la sdig tog mi dge ba'i bsam pa skye ba/ skyes bu gcig la dgra gnyen bar ma'i mthong 'dus nyid dgong ma dgos/ *// */ 'phral bar rgyal po la gnon kyang*/ phugs srong gi smon lam stobs las ston pa'i bstan pa la thog mar nyon (4na7)mongs pa'i dgra rtsad nas bcad par 'dug pas/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel bar 'gro bsam mo// yang*/ nyid mdo rgyud kyi gzhung rnams 'chad rtsong rtsom ma la spobs pa thogs pa mi 'dug ces/ skye bo sus kyang sku mdun phyin yang yid 'phrog cing rab tu dad pa cig yod 'dug /de ltar gnang ba de rang gi ji ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i don de gzhan la ston pa yin na ni chos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yin te/ rnam pa thams chad chos yongs su bsgrags pas sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa/ zhes dang*/ chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pa'i// 'gro sogs yang dag ji bzhin ston// zhes dang*/ chos smra ba'i gang zag de yon gnas mchog tu 'gyur bar gsungs shing*/

gzhung lugs de dag gi don gyi rtsa ba/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// zhes sogs dge sdig gi blang dor la thug pa ma lags sam/ yang byang chub sems kyi kun nas blangs pa'i nyams rtogs gang yang med par zang zing bsdu ba'i phyir nyan bshad dbang khrid sogs byed pa de ni bum pa stong pa phar je tshur jo byed pa dang 'dra bar/ jo bos bka' gdams 'thor bu ba las gsungs pa de thugs la mnga' mod/ mdor na nyid yul phyogs dang yul phyogs su byon nas lung rig gi nyan bshad/ dbang khrid man ngag sogs chos dang zang zing gnyis kyi sgo nas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad pa/ skabs la lar rab tu byung ba rnams kyis go gyon mtshon cha bsnams te/ pha rol pa'i lus dang srog dang longs spyod 'khor dang gnas rten sogs drag po'i sgo nas 'joms par byed pa 'di gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal ba 'dus pa'i phung por mthong byung bas/ 'gal 'du skyon med kyi lan bdag nyid dang bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa'i skye bo kun gyi yid yul du 'bab pa cig gnang ba mkhyen/ gsung ba 'di la/ chos bshad tshad rang gi rtogs pa sangs (4ba8)rgyas kho na'i khyad chos/ skyobs pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba zhes par 'dug pas khas mi lon// tshogs lam pas thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis go/ de bzhin du kho bo cag gis kyang so so skye bo'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar/ lung tshad mar byas pa'i bstan don gnas bshad pa byas pa yin/ gsung rab las sdig pa spangs dge bsgrub pa a cang*/ lar theg chen la 'jug 'os pa theg pa dman par khrid pa dang*/ theg dman du 'jug 'os pa theg chen du btsan khrid byas pa yin na gnyis ka rtsa ltung du bshad pa'ang go// lag len la 'chugs bsam pa med/ kho bo'i byas tshul gong du byas pa ltar yin pas sdig gam dge thugs bsam thong*/ dmag byas gsung ba de/ kong phyogs su nged kyi gzhan la gnod pa sbyong dgongs pa 'dra bas cung zad brjod par 'os 'dug

/de yang kho bos kong por kar srid pa'i phyogs ci byed kyi 'dug kyang*/ mi chung gcig dang sa gdan gang tsam shong ba'ang phrogs pa med/ khong rnams kong po lung par gzhan dgag bzhed par 'dug /khyad par da lo sgar chen nas kong po grwa pod thams cad rdzong ltar mdzad/ dgas man/ long po man spo bo yan gyi karma pa'i bla slob dpon grwa rigs tshang mas go gyon mtshon thogs/ yon bdag 'khul tshad bskul te bskor/ rgyogs dang me rgyogs/ dug sbyar ma chur blug pa sogs kho ngan pa las kyang ngan pa'i tshul la dpon slob thams cad rtse mthun/ nged cag kha phung du gtong rtsis mdzad song*/ nged kyi 'khris su gnas pa rnams kyi phyag mtshan ni rdo ba/ phub dang go ni lcags ri la bcol ba tsam/ rdas slobs sar ni khong rnams 'byon ma thub/ phyir ni nged kyis ma brdzangs pas sdig pa yi rang tsam gyis byung shas kha/ zla ba lnga'i rin 'bungs pas ni mtho ba/ nged kyi gtsug lag khang kong yul ba'i dper 'os pa cig rgyab pa de mer bsreg thub pa la (5na9)spa lor rtsi/ khyod chos kyi spyan ldan yin pas/ gtsug lag khang rgyab pa sdig gam// bshig pa sdig yin/ bshig pa dga' na glang dar ma bstod 'os su 'gro ba 'dra/ des na bslab ston 'di karma pa dpon slob kyi snyan du phul 'os pa 'dra bsam/ yang rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam du/ spre'u rang gi mi gtsang ba spre'u gzhan la bskud pa mthong ba/ ma 'ongs pa na shākya thub pa'i nyan thos rnams rang gi nyes pa gsangs nas gzhan gyi yin par bsgrag pa byung zhes par 'dug /yang drag po'i las de dag bstan pa spyi sgos la gnod pa'i/ sems can ma rungs pa zhi bas 'dul bar ma nus pa de dag /drag po'i sgo nas tshar gcad pa yin dgongs na ni/ dug gsum gyis kun nas blangs te tshar bcad na/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba yin pas ma yags thag chod/ byams snying rjes kun nas blangs pa yin na rab pha rol po'i bsam sbyor ngan pa 'dor du bcug nas/

mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la 'god pa cig dgos/ de ma byung na pha rol po'i gnod sems spangs/ zhu bshags phul bka' nyan gsung bsgrub byas dbang du 'dus pa cig dgos rgyu yin pa la/ phyi rol dgra bo btul rung gong nas gong du 'phel ba 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i drag po'i las tshogs rang min pa 'dra snyam/ gsung ba la sdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ zhes bsgral 'os ma bsgral na rtsa ltung*/ kho bo la mthu byas zhes kun gleng bslang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la mi byed par yi dam bcas pa yin/ bdag dang mi mthun phyogs su gnas pa rnams/ rna rdo gcig zos kyang 'thug pa'i mthu yin smra'o// da sgos rab byung gi gzugs com bstan 'dzin du mi snang bas/ drag sngags bkrol kyang dam bca' las 'gal ma'i 'gro 'am sems/ mi nag pa rnams sngar bshags pa phul ba'ang yod/ da lta dgra byas pas 'gyod pa'ang yod/ yang da byung gnod gang tshugs byed (5ba10)'ong bsam pa'ang yod pa/ 'tshengs bsam pa thog tu khel ba dka'/ mthu rabs bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod pa zer/ chos pa la dgra byung na ram zla bstan srung klog pa a cang*/ yang mdor na khyed theg pa chen po'i mdzad spyod/ rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pas gnas pa yin pas/ de la sbar tshod byas na bzod par gsol/ bdag ni blo chung theg pa dman pa yin pas/ dge 'dun dmag 'khrug byas te shi bas dbyung na/ dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan zhes pa de bden na ni ci dga' zin 'dug /gzhan yang rtsod pa ni nyes dmigs che zhing*/ rtsod pa med pa ni phan yon che ba yin te/ 'dul ba las rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun gsungs pa dang*/ rtsod pas gnyis ka rgyal ba med ces dang*/ bgres mos zhus pa'i mdo las yang na rtsod pa med pa de ni dge slong gi chos rnams kyi mchog go// zhes dang*/ a ti shas gang na rtsod pa yod pa'i phyogs nas dpag tshad brgya'i bar bros par bya zhes gsungs pas/

'di ltar phul ba 'di/ glog la mun pa'i gsal 'debs lta bur mi dgrongs par 'di rnams legs bshad las/ dam pa bden par smra na dge/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/ bdag rang sku mdun du 'ongs phyag 'bul byas pa zhu 'dod yod rung khams kyis ma lcogs pas bdag rngo ma thogs/ bdag ni sngon nas skyes stobs dang sbyor byung gi shes rab dman pas zhu ba'i yi ge dang sdebs sgra dag mtshams sbyor mkhas pa dgyes pa ma byung rung*/ don la dgongs dpyod gnang nas lan gcig gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes pa'i ri mo spyan ras g.yo ba'i yon mi 'gyur bar sangs rgyas rin chen gser/ dar dkar dri med chos/ sna tshogs dge 'dun gos zung ste/ dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgya ldan 'bul/ me phag gro zhun zla ba'i gral tshes brgyad la dgon gsar bla brang nas phul ba'i zhu yig /gsung ba nyid kyi thugs la pha rol gyis gnod pa ci skyal kyang byol lam ya ma byas na 'thus (6na11)dgongs pa 'dra// de ni rang gcig po la 'thus te/ mang po'i mgon du song bas de ltar ma 'thus phar rtsod su la'ang byed ma myong*/ dbus gtsang lho kong gang du yang*/ gzhan la chags sdang med pa'i khar phan 'dogs po'i blo rigs byas/ gzhan gyis ma 'thus pa snyigs dus su song bas yin mod/ de ka kham pa bzod pa bsgoms pa'i dpe kho na/ lan re lan gnyis rgur pas ma khyab pa cig byung*/ de na bdag gi bya ba kho na la rag ma las/ sa dge rnying ma su dang mi mthun pa ma byung kyang*/ rje karma dpon slob dang ma mthun pa cig byung*/ nged kyi 'dir ma 'thus pa byas gsung ba ni med/ brtags na/ ma 'jal ma btud pa la dgongs par ma bde ba los yin/ 'dud pa la/ chos 'dod nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos pa yin/ de lta bu ni chos ci zhu las mi snang*/ sa skya pa'i chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che lta bu bod gangs can la lung bsgyur ba zhig na/ bod du sdod mi sdod de la rag las pas 'dud dgos par mchi/

de ltar ni mi snang*/ dang po brgyud pa'i 'ded khungs de yin na'ang 'dud dgos te/ ded cag dpal phag mo gru pa'i ring lugs 'dzin par song bas 'brel mi snang*/ chos go ba'i mi la tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam thos nas kyang rten thabs ma nor ba cig /gzhan du khyi'i skye ba brgyad skyes nas/ rme sha can du'ang skye bar 'gyur/ gsung pa 'dug pas/ bla ma 'tshol ba la mi dga' ba de ltar yin/ rtsod pa med pa'i rgyu der thug byung bas/ ma nus pa la tshig gis sbyangs zer ba ltar 'dug /nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgres por song thugs kyis ma bzod par bslab ston phabs pa'i don zhu lan nang gtsang bas drang por phul/ 'di rnams la kun dpang du bzang chog pa yod/ (6ba12)yang bdag spyod pa rungs na/ khong grub mtha' mi gcig pa gzhan rnams kho bo la dad dang*/ dud dud ci la byed kyang gzigs par 'tshal/// /dge'o// chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la/ dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
